text.p: These are significant stories in the Nigerian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Central Bank acquires the wholly Nigerian-owned Great Merchant Bank which has been in financial distress; pays a nominal price of one naira.
- More than 50 people killed in road accident in eastern Nigeria.
- Drivers of road tankers shelve plans to go on strike over continued detention of a former oil union boss.

- State oil firm, Nigerian National Petroleum Corporation, plans to advise the federal military government against selling its 57 percent equity shares in joint ventures with multinational firms, sources in the corporation say.
- Manufacturers protest against additional charges on imported goods at the ports.
- Federal government to try to distinguish between genuine debtors and criminals in implementing failed banks decree.
